title: UX Refinement Source Gate: bare refinement false friends stop passing

ciFast.note: Fast verification is claimed only after v0.15.111 is pushed and the GitHub Actions run is attached.

deploy.note: Pages deploy is not claimed until the pushed v0.15.111 release completes its deploy run.

ciDeep.note: This is a narrow source relevance and grader-mirror release; focused source tests plus normal gates are the release bar.

liveProvider.note: The release is based on a fresh deployed v0.15.110 ZIP/log audit. A fresh deployed v0.15.111 audit is still required before claiming strict-clean provider output.

manualHuman.note: No external instructor approval is claimed by this release.

claims.summary: A fresh deployed v0.15.110 UX audit visibly exported 100/A, but strict source audit found data-refinement and vehicle-refinement false friends in trusted Crossref proof.
UX source retrieval and source-ledger export now require contextual design, prototype, studio, interface, interaction, portfolio, or user-experience anchors for refinement and critique concepts.

Known UX refinement false friends such as data refinement, failures-divergences refinement, vehicle refinement, automotive engineering, and critique-and-struggle metadata are rejected or quarantined before trusted proof.
The deep source-ledger grader mirrors the production source gate, so the captured v0.15.110 package regrades as 98/A with P1 citation findings instead of a false clean 100.
The release explicitly does not claim strict-clean provider output until a fresh deployed v0.15.111 ZIP/log audit proves false-friend source rows stay out and texture reaches the strict target.

knownRemainingTargets: Fresh deployed v0.15.111 ZIP/log audit must verify data-refinement and vehicle-refinement rows no longer reach trusted source-ledger proof.
Texture remains below the strict target in the v0.15.110 evidence at 95/100.
Genome linkage remains 0/12 in the v0.15.110 evidence.
